tagline: 理光便携相机，1985 年发布
description: 理光于1985年推出的便携相机。配备35 mm F2.8 Rikenon lens, 5 elements, 5 groups。使用Field of View Frame, Parallax Correction Marks, Auto-Focus Frame, Zone Marks Exposure Adjustment With SPD photocell. Exposure coupling range EV2 ~ EV17 (ISO 100)。感光度ISO 25 ~ ISO 1600 (in 1/3 steps). Compatible with the DX-code system。Automatic focusing with pre-focus facility.。

specs.镜头: 35 mm F2.8 Rikenon lens, 5 elements, 5 groups
specs.自拍: Built-in electronic type with sight and sound. Operating delay of approx. 10 sec.
specs.取景器: Albada type with bright-frame viewfinder (with parallax correction marks).
specs.胶片/画幅: Field of View Frame, Parallax Correction Marks, Auto-Focus Frame, Zone Marks Exposure Adjustment With SPD photocell. Exposure coupling range EV2 ~ EV17 (ISO 100)
specs.感光度: ISO 25 ~ ISO 1600 (in 1/3 steps). Compatible with the DX-code system
specs.闪光灯: Automatic turn on electronic flash in dim light
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh FF-90 is a compact camera for 35mm film.
